title: Planning leaves AGENTS.md out of an item's touches unless its goal edits it, since that touch makes every gate the worker adds blocking
goal: SP-ficl7pxl retrospective: ST-lcsgjg6p had AGENTS.md in its touches; the file is at its cap and the worker left it unedited, but every gate it added was classed agents-rule and made blocking, so the worker stopped with two open gates the orchestrator had to answer on its branch. BG-j35obxyn and ST-h3y6iym4 carried the same touch. The kb-sprint plan step 2 says an item names AGENTS.md in its touches only when its goal changes that file, and names the agents-rule class that touch gives each gate.

run: import sys;t=open('skills/sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read();s=t[t.find('2. See what covers'):t.find('3. Map the goal')];ok='agents-rule' in s and 'AGENTS.md' in s;print('plan step 2 names the AGENTS.md touch and its agents-rule class:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
